{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to correct for overconfidence.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows mean reversion (last 5-7 days trending downward).",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is below forecast, reduce next forecast by 10-15% to avoid overshoot after spikes.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to capture momentum.",
    "If sentiment is positive and forecast is consistently below true outcome, apply a ‘rebound bias’ correction: add 5-8% to forecast to align with upward momentum.",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day spikes: if forecast spikes > 10% above recent mean, reduce by 15-20% to prevent overcorrection.",
    "When sentiment is volatile (±0.50 or higher), use a smoothing filter: average last 3-5 forecasts before applying correction."
  ]
}
